arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
transliteration: Wa Huwa alladhī ja'ala al-layla wa al-nahāra khilfatan li-man arāda an yadhdhakkara aw arāda shukūrā
translation: And it is He who made the night and day as a succession for whoever desires to be reminded or desires gratitude.

arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْءًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
transliteration: Inna nāshi'ata al-layli hiya ashaddu wat'an wa aqwamu qīlā
translation: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence and more suitable for words.

arabic: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا
transliteration: Tatajāfā junūbuhum 'ani al-maḍāji'i yad'ūna rabbahum khawfan wa ṭama'ā
translation: Their sides forsake their beds; they call upon their Lord in fear and aspiration.

arabic: وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa bil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūn
translation: And in the hours before dawn they would seek forgiveness.

arabic: أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا
transliteration: Aqimi al-ṣalāta li-dulūki al-shamsi ilā ghasaqi al-layli wa qur'āna al-fajr, inna qur'āna al-fajri kāna mashhūdā
translation: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night and the Fajr recitation — indeed, the Fajr recitation is ever witnessed.

arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: Yusabbiḥu lillāhi mā fi al-samāwāti wa mā fi al-arḍ, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
translation: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him is due all praise, and He is over all things competent.

arabic: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ
transliteration: Wa al-ṣubḥi idhā asfar
translation: And by the dawn when it brightens.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
transliteration: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā ba'da idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā min ladunka raḥmah, innaka anta al-Wahhāb
translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

arabic: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
transliteration: Wa fi al-arḍi āyātun lil-mūqinīn
translation: And on the earth are signs for those who believe with certainty.

arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
transliteration: Wa mā tawfīqī illā billāh, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi unīb
translation: My success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
transliteration: Inna Allāha lā yuḍī'u ajra al-muḥsinīn
translation: Indeed, Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.

arabic: وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa lā tay'asū min rawḥi Allāh, innahu lā yay'asu min rawḥi Allāhi illā al-qawmu al-kāfirūn
translation: Do not despair of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.

arabic: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
transliteration: Allāhu nūru al-samāwāti wa al-arḍ
translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا
transliteration: Inna Allāha yumsiku al-samāwāti wa al-arḍa an tazūlā
translation: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease.

arabic: وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ
transliteration: Wa adhkur rabbaka fī nafsika taḍarru'an wa khīfatan wa dūna al-jahri min al-qawli bil-ghuduwwi wa al-āṣāl
translation: Remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being loud in words, in the mornings and the evenings.

arabic: حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَىٰ وَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ قَانِتِينَ
transliteration: Ḥāfiẓū 'alā al-ṣalawāti wa al-ṣalāti al-wusṭā wa qūmū lillāhi qānitīn
translation: Maintain with care the obligatory prayers and the middle prayer and stand before Allah, devoutly obedient.

arabic: فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ
transliteration: Fa-idhā qaḍaytumu al-ṣalāta fa-dhkurū Allāha qiyāman wa qu'ūdan wa 'alā junūbikum
translation: And when you have completed the prayer, remember Allah standing, sitting, or on your sides.

arabic: وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا
transliteration: Wa sabbiḥ bi-ḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulū'i al-shamsi wa qabla ghurūbihā
translation: And exalt the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting.

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ ۚ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Wa lillāhi al-mashriqu wa al-maghrib, fa-ayynamā tuwallū fa-thamma wajhu Allāh
translation: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah.

arabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ
transliteration: Wa min āyātihi al-laylu wa al-nahāru wa al-shamsu wa al-qamar
translation: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon.

arabic: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
transliteration: Alladhīna āmanū wa taṭma'innu qulūbuhum bi-dhikri Allāh, alā bi-dhikri Allāhi taṭma'innu al-qulūb
translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِالنَّهَارِ
transliteration: Wa Huwa alladhī yatawaffākum bil-layli wa ya'lamu mā jaraḥtum bil-nahār
translation: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day.

arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَاءُ وَتَنزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَاءُ
transliteration: Quli Allāhumma mālika al-mulki tu'tī al-mulka man tashā'u wa tanzi'u al-mulka mimman tashā'
translation: Say: O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Subḥāna alladhī khalaqa al-azwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu al-arḍu wa min anfusihim wa mimmā lā ya'lamūn
translation: Exalted is He who created all pairs — from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
